εἰκών, -όνος (cf. ἔοικα), 
[in LXX chiefly for צֶלֶם ;] 
an image, likeness: Mat.22.20, Mrk.12.16, Luk.20.24, Rom.1.23, 1Co.15.49, Rev.13.14, 15; 14.9, 11; 15.2; 16.2; 19.20; 20.4; opposite to σκιά, Heb.10.1 of man, εἰ. θεοῦ, 1Co.11.7; of the regenerate, εἰ. τ. θεοῦ Col.3.10 (see Lft., in l.); εἰ. τ. υἱοῦ τ. θεοῦ, Rom.8.29, 2Co.3.18; of Christ, εἰ. τ. θεοῦ, 2Co.4.4, Col.1.15.† SYN.: ὁμοίωμα, denoting resemblance, which may however be merely accidental. εἰ. is a derived likeness and like the head on a coin or the parental likeness in a child, implies an archetype. Cf. also εἶδος, appearance, not necessarily based on reality; σκιά, a shadowed resemblance; χαρακτήρ, the impress of a stamp;…

1) image
1a) images (of tumours, mice, heathen gods)
1b) image, likeness (of resemblance)
1c) mere, empty, image, semblance (fig.)
Aramaic equivalent: tse.lem (צְלֵם "image" H6755)

image, idol
Aramaic of tse.lem (צֶ֫לֶם "image" H6754)
image, idol
things formed, images, sculpted figures

1) image, ship, craft
1a) meaning very uncertain

A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.9.12; 
father of: Meshillemith (H4921)
§ Immer = "he hath said"
1) a priest in David's time
2) a priest in Jeremiah's time
3) the father of Zadok the priest
4) an ancestor of a priest
